title: Phase 1: Migrate Core Infrastructure - ServiceContainer to TypeScript DI
description: Migrate Python ServiceContainer to TypeScript using InversifyJS or tsyringe dependency injection framework. This is the foundation for all subsequent migrations, enabling dependency injection pattern in TypeScript. Must be completed after pre-migration refactoring (IMPL-001 to IMPL-004).

criteria: 1 TypeScript DI container created at src-ts/container/ServiceContainer.ts
Container supports lazy initialization pattern (properties with getters)
Container supports mock injection for testing (registerMock method)
Container supports async initialization with Promise-based pattern
Container registers 10+ core services: MemoryEngine, GraphEngine, SearchEngine, WorkflowEngine, AgentFactory, BackupManager, TokenService, ObsidianService, Reranker, MCPGateway
50+ unit tests created with vitest covering all container features
Python backend remains functional during migration (dual runtime)
convergence.verification: cd src-ts && npm test && ts-node -e "import { ServiceContainer } from './container/ServiceContainer'; const c = new ServiceContainer(); console.log('OK');"
convergence.definition_of_done: TypeScript DI container fully functional, enabling subsequent service migrations

files.change: TypeScript DI container with lazy initialization, mock injection, async init (200 lines)
TypeScript interfaces for all services (150 lines)
InversifyJS module for service registration (100 lines)
Vitest tests for container functionality (300 lines)
Add decorator support for DI framework

implementation.title: Select and configure DI framework
implementation.description: Choose between InversifyJS and tsyringe, configure TypeScript for decorators
modification_points: Add inversify and reflect-metadata to package.json
Update tsconfig.json with experimentalDecorators: true, emitDecoratorMetadata: true
Add reflect-metadata import in entry point
logic_flow: Evaluate InversifyJS vs tsyringe: InversifyJS has more features, tsyringe is simpler
Choose InversifyJS for production-grade DI with lazy loading support
Add dependencies: npm install inversify reflect-metadata inversify-binding-decorators
Update tsconfig.json compiler options
Create src-ts/container/ directory structure

implementation.title: Define TypeScript service interfaces
implementation.description: Create TypeScript interfaces for all services that will be registered in container
modification_points: Create src-ts/container/types.ts with 10+ service interfaces (150 lines)
Define ITokenService, IObsidianService, IReranker, IMCPGateway interfaces
logic_flow: Analyze Python ServiceContainer properties to identify services
Define interface for each service with method signatures
Use TypeScript 'interface' keyword for structural typing
Add Symbol identifiers for InversifyJS injection tokens
Document each interface with JSDoc comments

implementation.title: Implement ServiceContainer with lazy initialization
implementation.description: Create TypeScript ServiceContainer with lazy initialization and async pattern
modification_points: Implement lazy initialization with private _instance properties and getters
Implement async initialize() with Promise-based pattern
logic_flow: Import inversify Container and interfaces
Create ServiceContainer class with private container: Container
Implement private _services properties for lazy loading
Implement getters for each service with lazy initialization pattern
Add registerMock(serviceIdentifier, mock) method
Add async initialize() method for async service setup
Add reset() method for testing
Export singleton instance: export const container = new ServiceContainer()

implementation.title: Create InversifyJS binding module
implementation.description: Create ContainerModule with InversifyJS bindings for all services
modification_points: Define bindings for each service interface to implementation
Support both singleton and transient scopes
logic_flow: Create ContainerModule class extending inversify ContainerModule
Define bindings using bind<T>(SERVICE_IDENTIFIER).toDynamicValue(() => ...)
Configure singleton scope for stateful services
Configure transient scope for stateless services
Export containerModule for use in ServiceContainer

implementation.title: Add comprehensive test coverage
implementation.description: Create vitest tests for ServiceContainer covering all features
modification_points: Test lazy initialization for each service
Test error handling for missing services
logic_flow: Describe ServiceContainer test suite
Write test('lazy initialization') for each service getter
Write test('registerMock replaces service') with mock objects
Write test('async initialize completes') with async/await
Write test('singleton returns same instance') verifying instance reuse
Write test('get missing service throws error') for error cases
Run: cd src-ts && npm test
Verify 50+ tests pass

implementation.title: Validate integration and dual runtime
implementation.description: Ensure TypeScript container works alongside Python backend during migration
modification_points: Verify no conflicts with Python backend
Add integration test for TypeScript-Python coexistence
logic_flow: Run TypeScript tests: cd src-ts && npm test
Run Python tests: python -m pytest tests/ -v
Verify both test suites pass simultaneously
Document migration approach in README
Add src-ts/tests/integration/dual-runtime.test.ts
